title: Measurement choices
decision: A week is Monday to Monday in Tashkent time; the weekly figures are totals over all shops and not per shop; the export is a command an operator runs and is not yet in the administrator's panel
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 35
rationale: Per-shop figures would put a shop reference into data that ADR-010 keeps free of identity
